fieldValues.title: 2. The board model: value and order
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Epic Priority P0 to P2 (rank 1 = P0, 2 = P1, 3+ = P2, unranked = parked), derived from the period ranking by clerk roadmap and never set by hand; story MoSCoW (Must, Should, Could, Won't) set by a human; a derived 'priority: Pn' label on implementation issues; bump labels (critical-path, blocks-gate, regression); a bug floor of P1; and eight milestone:* labels in semanticops.com and muDemocracy.org, plus five native GitHub milestones in srs-rust. An epic is a release. One statement: clerk docs/board.md and the handbook (Project #6 'SemanticOps'). srs-rust's docs/project-management.md now says 'Moved' and points to the clerk (commit dd8e47a8, 2026-10-11).
fieldValues.tensions:
- milestone:* labels and native milestones name releases, while the board model says an epic is a release.
- srs-programme's CLAUDE.md restates the rule (reprioritise by editing objective_rank), a second statement of one rule.
- A stale local srs-rust checkout still shows the retired copy that said epic Priority was hand-set; an agent reading it would act on the old rule.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Do milestone:* labels and native milestones still mean anything the derivation reads?
fieldValues.next_action: Retire milestone labels if nothing reads them (planning).
